mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 315.0 indicates persistent inflation, prompting expectations of prolonged high interest rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 315.0 (over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong labor market growth (PAYEMS) and low unemployment (UNRATE) indicates economic overheating, leading to expectations of aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of triggered instances (over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST declines (t-test p > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening manufacturing activity and economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline does not correlate with negative 60-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals economic distress, prompting expectations of rapid monetary easing and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% (over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) remains high and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is not cut, the market prices in prolonged high interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between high CPIAUCSL and high FEDFUNDS does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases (over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a slowdown in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals an impending recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 slowdown does not correlate with negative 60-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.
